answer_text:
# FEED-2207 — Prairie Gate receiving ticket sources

Grower-feed batch **FEED-2207** was milled from Hearthland intake **HFM-IN-602**. That receipt traces to Prairie Gate loadout dispatch **PGE-OUT-5002** (26,000 kg from North House 12 / bin B-12 on 2025-09-04).

On the hopper/loadout paperwork for **PGE-OUT-5002**, the named Prairie Gate receiving tickets are:

- **WB-390** (Willow Bend Farms)
- **EF-18** (East Fork Co-op)

## Trace

| Step | Record | Detail |
|------|--------|--------|
| Mill output | FEED-2207 | grower feed (run MILL-2207) |
| Mill intake | HFM-IN-602 | 25,500 kg received 2025-09-05 |
| Elevator loadout | PGE-OUT-5002 | 26,000 kg from North House 12 |
| Named sources | WB-390, EF-18 | receiving tickets cited on loadout paperwork |

The prior B-12 loadout (**PGE-OUT-5001**, 39,000 kg) aligns with ticket **DR-44** (39,900 kg received). The remaining grain drawn for **PGE-OUT-5002** therefore comes from the next receipts in that bin — **WB-390** (23,850 kg) and the start of **EF-18** (2,150 kg of its 17,900 kg), which matches the 26,000 kg loadout quantity.
